features: LARGE STORAGE CAPACITY: The Arketing 256GB Micro TF Card offers ample space to store photos, videos, music, and files.
HIGH-SPEED PERFORMANCE: Rated Class 10 and UHS-I U3, this card delivers fast read and write speeds ideal for 4K video recording.
WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with smartphones, tablets, cameras, dash cams, and other devices that support microSD or TF cards.
RELIABLE BUILD: Designed for consistent performance, this card is built to handle everyday use across a variety of supported devices.
COMPACT DESIGN: The micro form factor makes it easy to carry and use across multiple devices without taking up extra space.
description: The Arketing 256GB Micro TF Card is a high-capacity memory solution designed to meet the storage demands of modern devices. Rated Class 10 and UHS Speed Class 3 (U3), this card delivers fast and reliable read and write speeds, making it ideal for recording high-definition videos, capturing burst-mode photographs, and storing large files with ease. Whether you are using it in a smartphone, tablet, action camera, or dash cam, this microSD card offers seamless compatibility across a wide range of devices. The generous 256GB storage capacity ensures you never have to worry about running out of space for your photos, videos, music, or apps. Its compact form factor makes it easy to carry and swap between devices without any hassle. The U3 rating guarantees smooth 4K video recording performance, making it a dependable choice for content creators and everyday users alike. Upgrade your device's storage with this robust and high-performing memory card and enjoy uninterrupted access to all your digital content.
